value_gate.reason: B2a Value diagnostics are descriptive; no inferential ROI gate has been frozen.

rationale.q_max: Global FDR 0.05 controls the family of current child hypotheses; 144/735 B2a rows were <=0.05.
rationale.bootstrap: All q<=0.05 rows also excluded zero at 95% bootstrap CI; requiring both freezes agreement between analytic and resampling evidence.
rationale.yearly_min_n: Sensitivity retained 100 candidates at n=5, 94 at n=10, and only 59 at n=20 under the final temporal structure. n=10 removes sparse-year signs without the sharp n=20 loss.
rationale.min_eligible_years: At yearly n>=10, requiring 4/6/8 eligible years retained 111/94/64 candidates under the final direction rules; six years is the middle stability point.
rationale.full_period_fraction: Two-thirds is an interpretable supermajority and preserves stable recent reversals rather than requiring agreement with v0.2.
rationale.recent_fraction: Three of the four most recent eligible years must agree with the full-history incremental direction.
